drills.title: Alignment & assignment walkthrough
drills.objective: Every defender can name alignment, key and first step against the shown look.
drills.setup: Scout group sets the card at walk tempo. Defense in its base front.
steps: Scout look sets on the coach's call.
Defense aligns and calls the formation out loud.
Coach checks alignment, then “go” at walk tempo.
Reset and show the next card.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL cue (generic): Eyes to the key before the snap.
REFERENCE / FICTIONAL cue (generic): Talk: name the strength out loud.

drills.title: Formation recognition flash
drills.objective: Name the formation and its strength within a three-count.
drills.setup: Coach holds up scout cards; players answer as a unit.
steps: Show a card for a three-count.
Unit calls formation and strength.
Coach confirms or corrects, next card.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL cue (generic): Count receivers to each side first.

drills.title: Pursuit angles (no contact)
drills.objective: Take a leverage angle to the ball and finish to a cone landmark.
drills.setup: Ball carrier in pinnie runs to a cone; defenders start from alignment.
steps: Carrier breaks to a sideline cone.
Defenders take an angle that stays inside-out.
Finish through the landmark cone, no contact.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL cue (generic): Aim in front of the ball, not at it.

drills.title: Zone drop landmarks
drills.objective: Open to the correct landmark and find the nearest threat.
drills.setup: Landmark cones at generic depths; coach signals the drop.
steps: Coach signals the drop.
Open and work to the landmark.
Eyes to the throw-side threat, break on the point.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL cue (generic): Get to depth before widening.

drills.title: Block-shed fits (fit tempo)
drills.objective: Fit into the assigned gap with hands inside and eyes on the ball.
drills.setup: Hand shields held by scout line; tempo set by the coach.
steps: Shield holder shows a block angle.
Defender fits the gap at fit tempo.
Shed to the ball side on the whistle.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL cue (generic): Hands inside, keep the outside arm free.

drills.title: Run fit vs. scout look
drills.objective: Fill assigned gaps against the scout look's run.
drills.setup: Scout skill + line show the card; defense fits on the snap.
steps: Scout group runs the card at coach tempo.
Defense fits gaps, coach freezes on the whistle.
Check every gap is owned, then reset.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL cue (generic): Every gap owned once, nobody twice.

drills.title: Pattern read vs. skeleton look
drills.objective: Recognize the route pattern and match the threat to the zone.
drills.setup: Scout pass group runs card routes, no line.
steps: Scout QB calls the card.
Routes run on the snap, ball thrown on time.
Coach reviews the read after each rep.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL cue (generic): Read the inside receiver's release first.

drills.title: Rush-lane integrity
drills.objective: Keep rush lanes so the passer has no clean escape.
drills.setup: Scout line on bags; rushers work their lanes.
steps: Line sets on bags.
Rushers attack their lane on the snap.
Freeze on the whistle and check lanes.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL cue (generic): Stay in your lane; collapse together.

drills.title: Ball-security / takeaway circuit
drills.objective: Finish plays by attacking the ball in a controlled circuit.
drills.setup: Three stations, rotate on the whistle.
steps: Station 1: scoop-and-secure.
Station 2: tip drill.
Station 3: high-point catch.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL cue (generic): Eyes on the ball through the catch.

drills.title: Situations: call-and-check
drills.objective: Recognize down, distance and look; get the call in and check correctly.
drills.setup: Coach announces a situation; scout group shows a card.
steps: Coach states down, distance, field position.
Signal the call; scout sets the look.
Defense checks if needed; run the rep at coach tempo.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL cue (generic): Get the call, then get the look.

drills.title: Team vs. scout look
drills.objective: Execute the call as a unit against a sequence of scout looks.
drills.setup: Full scout offense shows cards in script order.
steps: Scout group huddles with the card.
Defense gets the call.
Rep at coach tempo; coach corrects between reps.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL cue (generic): Communicate the strength before the snap.

cards.title: Trips Right — gun
cards.notes: Sample trips look to the field. Count three receivers to the right and call strength right.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL: Strength is to the trips side in this sample.

cards.title: Twins Left — under center
cards.notes: Two receivers left, inline tight end right, single back. Generic run look.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL: Two receivers to one side, tight end to the other.

cards.title: Empty 3x2
cards.notes: No back in the backfield. Three receivers left, two right.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL: Empty: five eligible receivers spread out.

cards.title: Bunch Right — gun
cards.notes: Three receivers stacked tight to the right. Releases cross quickly.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL: Bunch: tight split, releases cross.

cards.title: Pro I — offset fullback
cards.notes: Two backs stacked, fullback offset strong. Generic downhill run look.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL: Two backs: count the extra blocker.

cards.title: Doubles 2x2 — gun
cards.notes: Two receivers each side, one back. Balanced passing look.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL: Balanced: identify the back's side.

cards.title: Heavy — two tight ends
cards.notes: Tight ends on both sides plus a wing. Short-yardage sample look.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL: Heavy: extra blockers on both edges.

cards.title: Pistol — wing right
cards.notes: Back directly behind the QB, wing off the tight end. Motion across is common in this sample.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL: Motion can change strength — re-count.

cards.title: Ace — twins right
cards.notes: Single back, tight end left, two receivers right.
cues: REFERENCE / FICTIONAL: Tight end and twins on opposite sides.
